<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (m/z ≈ 183 [M+H]⁺) and the 13C NMR data (nine distinct carbons: a carbonyl at ~169 ppm, six aromatic carbons, a benzylic CH₂ at ~43 ppm, and a methyl carbon at ~26 ppm), the compound is best described as a phenylpropionic acid bearing two phenolic hydroxyl groups. The molecular formula derived from the SMILES is C₉H₁₀O₄, which matches the observed mass. The validated SMILES string for this structure is **O=C(O)CCc1ccc(O)cc1O**.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(O)CCc1ccc(O)cc1O</final_answer>
